moments.frontstage: Enrollment: accept Zelle Service Agreement and Privacy Notice; set the Zelle Contact Method (only the primary email or a mobile number already in the online-banking profile); select the one account used for all Zelle sends and receipts; 'Validate Account' screen sends a one-time passcode by email/SMS to prove possession of the token; name, bank name and token are shared with Zelle (account details stay with Fifth Third). One contact method per customer; token already enrolled elsewhere → call 800-972-3030 to move it.

fail_points.text: Token already enrolled elsewhere -> enrollment error; must call to move it

moments.frontstage: Directory lookup: contacts show tokens as 'Suggested' (already enrolled in Zelle) or 'Available' (valid but not enrolled); manual entry link at the bottom does not update the address book. The bank checks the name registered to the token and warns when it does not match the address-book name; payment always goes to the name found in the network.

fail_points.text: Name-mismatch warning may be a harmless nickname difference or a token registered to a different person; customer must self-verify or risk paying the wrong person.

Cannot cancel; told to call immediately
exceptions.bank_handling: Bank may contact recipient bank; no guarantee

exceptions.trigger: Customer reports an imposter/APP scam after an authorized Zelle payment
exceptions.customer_experience: Consumer guidance (07/2026 article): an authorized payment made under deception is a 'scam' and 'you may not be able to get your money back because you authorized the payment'; unauthorized (fraud) payments 'you are usually able to get your money back'. Consumer calls 800-972-3030 (Mon–Fri 8–6, Sat 10–4 ET); business Zelle FAQ: call 877-534-2264 — 'Qualifying imposter scams may be eligible for reimbursement.' No Zelle-specific scam claim form or consumer reimbursement statement.
exceptions.bank_handling: Zelle network-level imposter-scam claw-back (since 6/30/2023) applies to participants; Fifth Third's specific claim form/timeline not published

exceptions.trigger: Unauthorized Zelle payment (account takeover, e.g., OTP phishing then Zelle enrollment)
exceptions.customer_experience: Customer calls fraud line 800-972-3030; disputes via 877-833-6197 Disputes Resolution Department; advised to change credentials, renumber accounts
exceptions.bank_handling: Reg E investigation (standard); SmartShield suspicious-activity controls; 'Zelle fraud identification before you pay'
exceptions.resolution: Provisional credit/final resolution per Reg E (INFERRED)

exceptions.trigger: Money sent to a token the customer has not enrolled (e.g., email when the mobile number is enrolled)
exceptions.customer_experience: Customer sees a Zelle notification but the payment is not credited
exceptions.bank_handling: Customer calls 800-972-3030 to have the registered contact method deactivated and re-enrolls with the other token; or asks the sender to cancel and resend
exceptions.resolution: Re-enrollment or resend; first payment after enrollment may take 2-3 days

assessment: Clean two-tap path (Move Money > Send Money with Zelle) and QR codes; weak public documentation of in-flow scam warnings and limits; single-contact-method restriction and phone-only limit disclosure are friction points.

terms.limits: Not published; shown in-app on recipient screen; no receive limit at Fifth Third [S011,S031]
terms.fees: None for personal and business checking [S001,S003]
terms.cutoffs: Minutes if enrolled; 1–3 business days after enrollment if not [S007]
